name: Bland AI
positioning: A vertically integrated voice agent platform that owns telephony, speech, language model and orchestration and sells a single bundled per-minute rate, with a forward-deployed engineering service for larger deployments.

pricing.model: Plan-based per-minute rate that bundles LLM, speech-to-text and text-to-speech (no token charges); platform fee on higher plans; custom enterprise contracts.
pricing.headline: $0.14 per minute on the free Start plan, $0.12 per minute on Build ($299 per month); LLM, speech-to-text and text-to-speech are included, telephony is billed separately.
planNotes: Start: $0 platform fee, $0.14 per minute talk time, $0.05 per transfer minute, 10 concurrent calls, 100 calls per day, 10 knowledge bases, 1 voice.
Build: $299 per month, $0.12 per minute, $0.04 per transfer minute, 50 concurrent calls, 2,000 calls per day, 50 knowledge bases, 5 voices.
Enterprise: custom pricing; BAA, SSO, data residency, on-prem/VPC and forward-deployed engineers listed.
Bland docs also list a Scale plan ($499 per month, $0.11 per minute, $0.03 transfer) that did not appear on the public pricing page read on the retrieval date.
Docs also list an Agent Phone plan at $29.99 for a single agent number with unlimited US/Canada voice minutes and SMS.
Outbound calls on Bland telephony carry a $0.015 minimum charge per attempt (docs); transfer fees do not apply when using your own Twilio account.
pricing.freeTrial: Start plan is free with no card required and includes starter credits and an inbound number valued at $15 per month (the credit amount is not specified on the page).
whatIsExtra: Telephony: billed separately, either on your own carrier or Bland's at pass-through cost (pricing FAQ)
Transfer minutes when using Bland-provided numbers
SMS: $0.02 per message; web-widget agent messages $0.01 per message (docs)
Outbound minimum $0.015 per call attempt on Bland telephony (docs)

strengths.claim: Simple bundled pricing: one per-minute rate covers the language model, transcription and voice, with no token charges or model pass-throughs.
Stated compliance coverage (SOC 2 Type I and II, HIPAA-eligible with BAA, GDPR, PCI DSS) and on-prem/VPC deployment for regulated enterprises.
Hands-on enterprise delivery: a forward-deployed engineering team and a documented 28-day deployment framework for enterprise rollouts.
Visual Conversational Pathways builder for branching call flows, with SIP trunk support, number porting and Twilio integration.
Large-scale infrastructure: docs state it owns the full stack and supports very high concurrency (up to 1 million concurrent calls on the vendor's own claim).

limitations.claim: Per-day and per-hour call caps apply on self-serve plans (100 calls per day on Start, 2,000 on Build); unlimited caps are listed for Enterprise.
Compliance items such as BAA, SSO and data residency are listed under the Enterprise plan, and compliance documentation is available under NDA on Enterprise.
Bland states that all production pathways and personas must be migrated to its new agent architecture by November 15, 2026.

integrations: SIP trunks from any carrier or contact-center platform

compliance.note: Stated by vendor, self-attested: pricing FAQ and docs say SOC 2 Type I and Type II, HIPAA-eligible with a signed BAA, GDPR and PCI DSS; compliance documentation is provided under NDA on Enterprise. BAA is listed as an Enterprise feature.

telephony.providedNumbers: Bland numbers on its built-in Twilio at pass-through cost; own Twilio account and SIP trunks (with number porting) are supported. Specific countries for Bland numbers were not listed on the pages read.

stepsToLeave: Read pathway definitions (nodes and edges) with the Get All Pathways / Get Single Pathway API.
Export conversations and transcripts from the Conversations view or API.

Numbers on your own Twilio account or SIP trunk stay with you and can be repointed; numbers bought from Bland would need a replacement or a port-out request (port-out process not documented in pages read).
Recreate prompts, tools and knowledge in the new platform and test before cutover.

bestFor: Mid-market and enterprise teams that want a single bundled per-minute rate and hands-on engineering help for regulated or high-volume phone automation.
unknowns: The Scale plan ($499, $0.11 per minute) appears in docs but not on the public pricing page; which is current is unconfirmed.
Whether telephony is included or extra on the self-serve per-minute rate: the pricing FAQ says it is billed separately at pass-through, but no per-minute carrier rate was found.
Free-trial credit amount ('2 credits') is not defined in dollars.
Number port-out process for Bland-purchased numbers not found.
Compliance reports are under NDA and were not seen.
